profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Unum
profile.summary:
Detail-oriented software developer with 10+ years of experience designing, building, integrating, securing, and supporting enterprise applications — web applications, web services, and batch processing systems — with a focus on financial services and investment data infrastructure. I've contributed to and led software solutions that serve portfolio managers, pricing analysts, and credit analysts, turning complex market and pricing data into tools they can actually rely on.
 
Lately my work sits at the intersection of cloud and AI engineering. As an AWS Certified Developer – Associate, I'm building on services like Bedrock, Lambda, and OpenSearch to bring generative AI and retrieval-based systems into investment workflows — from data pipelines to analyst-facing dashboards. I rely on strong analytical and problem-solving skills every day, and it's those same challenges that keep me learning and applying new technologies as the field moves.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
I collaborate with business unit stakeholders to design and build application systems that expand the company's finance and investing capabilities, partnering with development and testing teams to deliver solutions engineered for functionality, scalability, and performance.
 
Selected work:
 
> Built and maintain investment data pipelines integrating market data, pricing, and trade-file feeds into a centralized Investment Data Layer
> Delivered a real-time trade integration that improved the speed and reliability of position and transaction processing
> Led a database platform migration to meet compliance and security requirements
> Developed a reusable data-integration component to streamline retrieval of broker and pricing information
> Maintain a credit scoring assessment module supporting credit risk analysis

positions.title: Application Systems Analyst - Specialist
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
- Responsible for the estimation, design, implementation, and maintenance of new and existing features for the existing portfolio of applications for HR and Financial Information Systems.
- Design, code, configure, unit test, maintain, and document software deliverables using agreed upon standards and tools.
- Serve one or more project team roles, such as development/technical lead, and systems analyst for medium to large efforts.
- Develop ERP solutions using Workday, Workday APIs, EIBs, Connectors, Workday Studio, and Workday Cloud Platform
- Design and develop and secure full stack solutions for Human Resources and Financial information systems using .NET (C#/ASP.NET MVC/Web API/Entity Framework) and Javascript (React/Angular)
- Lead development and design of ASP.NET MVC web application that captures employee time punches in the event of SaaS (Cloud ERP, Workday) downtime
- Implemented and maintained over 10 batch applications that support ETL operations using .NET Console (C#), Entity Framework, and SQL Server
- Designed, developed and deployed Workday Integrations to load and extract data from the Workday Cloud ERP System (Java, MVEL, XSLT)
- Designed and Implemented web applications to interact with both SOAP and RESTful web services (incl. ReactJS/Angular/.NET Core MVC & Web API)
- Built a web application to read archived data from HR’s Taleo DB2 database with allows users to search requisitions, candidates and their applications.

positions.title: Applications Developer/Analyst
positions.description:
> Lead the design, development and deployment of a SOAP-based Web Service that reads JSON data uploaded from a mobile app and generates PDF documents (C#/WCF/Entity Framework)
> Made significant contributions to the development of a testing application that scraped hundreds HTML templates and provided sample data for input fields including (Select, Radio and Checkbox fields)
> Devised interactions, and connections with the IBM OnDemand document repositories.
> Developed desktop application using (Microsoft WPF/C#) that enabled hundreds of Care Coordinators to Generate PDF documents for preview in the field when no internet connect is available.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
-	Analyzed business requirements and designed, built, tested and implemented applications Web-based applications using JavaScript, JavaEE, JSP and Struts
-	Tested hybrid mobile applications and modify HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript to optimize end-user experience 
-	Designed and developed enhancements to BCBST Member Mobile Application
-	Developed and provided technical support to applications maintained by our team
-	Worked with team on projects and follow deadlines enforced in a Agile/Scrum-based environment
-	Researched, gathered and compiled information on client needs and business and industry trends

positions.title: Technician
positions.description:
> Installed over 170 HP Thin Client devices in 19 Wal-Mart Stores
> Troubleshoot network problems and Thin Client connectivity issues
> Analyze, test and verify connectivity to the Walmart network

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
-	Designed and developed MS Access database applications to monitor and track budgetary expenditures, analyze budgets to determine the distribution of monies for capital investment and expenditures in excess of 3 million dollars
-	Planned, Designed and Developed a Field Management application using Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) with MS Access to track the application of pesticide, fertilizers, grass and other products to grounds fields.
-	Utilized strong oral and written communication skills to present ideas and document complex financial information and annual reports
-	Applied technical knowledge to projects, in order to insure accountability, accuracy and timeliness of project deliverables
-	Designed, developed and maintained a complex spreadsheet application with MS Excel for analyzing budgets to determine the distribution of monies for capital investment and expenditures in excess of 3 million dollars
